validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real, correctly classified. P4036 is one of 14 named 'FGT expansion phase' laterals in this batch (roster P4028-P4040/P4050/P4060) plus 4 more elsewhere in the roster (P2529, P2594, P2627, P2738) that together represent Florida Gas Transmission's decades of incremental FERC-certificated expansion phases -- not one undifferentiated trunk. The sheet's own cited sources for this gem.wiki page are: [1] 'A Barrel Full' (banned per standing rule 5, read for leads only, never cited), [2] the operator's ipost system-map portal, [3] eia.gov/maps layer-info page (a navigation page, not a ref), [4] eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php ('U.S. natural gas pipeline projects', cited 40+ times on this page -- itself a navigation page, so I resolved it to the actual downloadable workbook it points to), [5] Kinder Morgan's legacy FGT page (now 404, confirmed dead -- KM co-owns FGT via Citrus Corp but no longer hosts a live FGT project page at that URL), [7] FracTracker's 2020 National Energy and Petrochemical Map, [9] oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/6491 (a JS-rendered EIP Oil & Gas Watch page; curl returns only the app shell, content unreadable without a browser -- could not verify, flagged not used). DUPLICATE CHECK: confirmed NOT a duplicate. Cross-referenced against the EIA 'Historical Projects (1996-2020)' tab of EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Jan2021.xlsx (eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/), which carries a distinct, independently-dated, independently-costed row for every one of the 14 FGT phase rows in this batch's roster (Phase IV, Phase V Stages 1-2, Phase V Stage 3 [this row], Phase V Stage 4, Phase VI, Phase VII Phase 1, Phase VIII, Turkey Point Lateral, East Leg Expansion, Western Division, Jacksonville, Sanford, AE Cooperative Upgrade, Alabama Power Lateral, Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion, East Louisiana, South Alabama, East-West) with its own FERC docket number, completion date and cost -- these are genuinely 14+ separate certificated construction projects, not one project double- or triple-counted under different names. See cross_row_leads for the PID-level matches. SPEC: every quantitative GEM value for P4036 (Length 15 mi, Diameter 24 in, Capacity 180 MMcf/d, SegmentCost $13,000,000, StartYear1 2002, Status operating) matches the EIA table's 'FGT Phase V Stage 3' row (row 330) EXACTLY -- Miles=15, Pipeline Diameter=24, Additional Capacity=180, Cost (millions)=13, Year In Service Date=2002, Status=Completed, Docket Number=CP00-40 (shared with Phase V Stages 1-2 and Stage 4, confirming all three were filed as one certificate application, consistent with a single project split into stages rather than a fabricated/duplicated row). SECOND SOURCE: this is a single-origin corroboration (one EIA workbook) for the numeric values -- I searched for a second independent source and could not land one within this pass: FERC eLibrary's docket search (elibrary.ferc.gov) is a JS-driven interface that a scripted GET cannot query for CP00-40 directly; the fgttransfer.energytransfer.com ipost portal (Energy Transfer, verified live and used below for Status/Operator) lists 'Florida Gas Transmission' as a current ET pipeline asset but states no project-level specs; oilandgaswatch.org's pipeline detail page is JS-rendered and unreadable via curl; Kinder Morgan's legacy FGT project page 404s; scripted DuckDuckGo/Bing/Google searches returned bot-check pages with no results (no browser available in this environment). Given the EIA table is a government regulatory dataset (independent of GEM and of the operator) and every figure matches exactly, I'm staging these as REFS_ADDED at tier=medium (single strong source) rather than leaving them unsourced -- a future pass should try FERC eLibrary interactively for the CP00-40 order itself, which would supply an independent second confirmation plus the still-missing Proposal/Construction dates and MAOP/Pressure.
